action_attempted: Open Customer E claim review panel from existing claims list
expected: Claim review panel shows existing open/resolved claims and lets analyst select ORD-2025-00412
actual: Panel shows Previous claims 0 and “No claims recorded” even though /claims lists three Customer E claims.
merchant_experience: Analyst cannot review or close the critical watchlisted customer claim from the profile panel; existing merchant data appears lost.
fix_summary: Added a fallback /api/claims read path for live schemas missing order_ref/order_source and switched profile ownership validation to fetchMerchantScopedCustomerProfile.
retest_result: Passed: Customer E claim panel now shows ORD-2025-00412 and prior resolved claims.

action_attempted: Deny Customer E open claim and clear it from the queue
expected: Saving a final decision resolves/closes the claim or exposes a clear close action so it leaves the open queue.
actual: Outcome row is saved, but claim status remains open and ORD-2025-00412 still appears in /claims?status=open.
merchant_experience: Analyst records the decision but the queue never clears, making throughput and KPI counts untrustworthy.
fix_summary: Outcome save now verifies merchant ownership by claim.merchant_id or owned shop and updates merchant_claims.status to resolved.
retest_result: Passed: Customer E disappeared from open filter and appeared in resolved filter.

action_attempted: Upload CSV with three refund_requested=true rows and inspect processed results
expected: Uploaded refund-requested rows persist as refund_claimed=true and feed customer claim/profile signals.
actual: The job completed, but all uploaded rows were stored with refund_claimed=false despite refund_requested=true in the CSV.
merchant_experience: Merchant uploads real refund claim data, but the fraud system silently treats claims as non-claims, undercounting risk and hiding support workload.
fix_summary: Persisted refund_claimed now treats refund_requested=true/yes/1/y as a claim even when refund_status is absent.
retest_result: Passed: fresh CSV upload persisted all three refund_requested rows as refund_claimed=true.

action_attempted: Create Customer D first missing-parcel claim from the order picker
expected: Claim saves and remains visible after navigation.
actual: Order picker shows ORD-2025-00501, but Save claim returns “Failed to upsert claim.”
merchant_experience: Analyst cannot file a new claim for a CSV/audit order, blocking support and fraud review work.
fix_summary: Claim create now falls back to legacy shopify_order_id storage when live DB lacks order_ref/order_source columns, while preserving merchant/shop ownership.
retest_result: Passed: Customer D claim saved and remained visible after navigating away and back.

phase: Addendum A — Search by Order Reference
action_attempted: Search for a customer/claim by full and partial order reference
expected: Correct customer/claim appears for ORD-2025-00341 and 00341.
actual: Name/email search works, but both full and partial order reference searches return no customers.
merchant_experience: Support cannot look up a claim while a customer is on the phone with only an order number.
fix_summary: Customers search now detects order-reference queries and resolves profiles through merchant-owned claims and audit transactions.
retest_result: Passed: full and partial ORD-2025-00341 searches return Priya Mehta.

phase: Addendum B — Claim Aging and SLA
action_attempted: Prioritise oldest/urgent claims from the claims table
expected: Filed date, age, or SLA column plus sort by age/date filed.
actual: Claims table only shows Updated date; no age, filed date, SLA, or urgency indicator.
merchant_experience: Team cannot reliably prioritise aging claims or manage SLA breach risk.
fix_summary: Added filed date, age, SLA badges, SLA filters, age sorting, resolved-duration handling, and inbox claim urgency metrics.
tests_run: npx jest tests/api/claimsRoutes.test.ts tests/api/auditTrailClaims.test.ts tests/lib/claimsSla.test.ts tests/lib/customerResponses.test.ts tests/lib/claimsReporting.test.ts tests/lib/claimsWorkflowClient.test.ts tests/lib/claimsStore.test.ts --runInBand
retest_result: Passed: /claims shows filed date, age, SLA badges and sorting; /inbox shows claims urgency and oldest active age.

action_attempted: Reopen or reverse Customer E denied/resolved claim
expected: A Reopen/Reverse/Edit decision action with visible reversal history.
actual: No reopen, reverse, or decision-edit affordance is visible in claim review.
merchant_experience: A legal escalation or carrier correction cannot be reflected without creating ambiguous duplicate outcomes.
fix_summary: Added merchant-scoped reopen and reverse routes, required reasons, preserved previous outcomes in immutable events, and surfaced current/previous decision details in the panel.
tests_run: npx jest tests/api/claimsRoutes.test.ts tests/api/auditTrailClaims.test.ts tests/lib/claimsSla.test.ts tests/lib/customerResponses.test.ts tests/lib/claimsReporting.test.ts tests/lib/claimsWorkflowClient.test.ts tests/lib/claimsStore.test.ts --runInBand
retest_result: Passed: resolved claim reopened to under review, reversal preserved the old denied/suspected-fraud outcome and showed the new approved/legitimate outcome.

action_attempted: Assess whether duplicate claim for same order/type is prevented
expected: Warning or prevention when the same order/ref/type already has an active claim.
actual: No duplicate warning is visible before saving; workflow allows selecting an existing order and entering a new claim/update context ambiguously.
merchant_experience: Support can accidentally create or overwrite duplicate claims, confusing claim counts and customer comms.
fix_summary: Added API-enforced duplicate detection for active same merchant/order/type claims, resolved-duplicate reopen guidance, and a visible claim-panel warning.
tests_run: npx jest tests/api/claimsRoutes.test.ts tests/api/auditTrailClaims.test.ts tests/lib/claimsSla.test.ts tests/lib/customerResponses.test.ts tests/lib/claimsReporting.test.ts tests/lib/claimsWorkflowClient.test.ts tests/lib/claimsStore.test.ts --runInBand
retest_result: Passed: duplicate active missing-parcel claim warning appeared and Save claim did not silently overwrite or create a duplicate.

action_attempted: Move to next claim after resolving one
expected: Next claim / previous claim navigation or queue shortcuts after resolution.
actual: No next-claim navigation is visible after outcome save; analyst must return to /claims or /inbox manually.
merchant_experience: High-volume fraud teams lose throughput and context during live queue clearing.
fix_summary: Added post-decision Next claim and Back to queue actions, a next unresolved-claim lookup using current queue ordering, and a no-more-open-claims completion state.
tests_run: npx jest tests/api/claimsRoutes.test.ts tests/api/auditTrailClaims.test.ts tests/lib/claimsSla.test.ts tests/lib/customerResponses.test.ts tests/lib/claimsReporting.test.ts tests/lib/claimsWorkflowClient.test.ts tests/lib/claimsStore.test.ts --runInBand
retest_result: Passed: after resolving a claim, Next claim and Back to queue appeared; Next claim opened another unresolved claim from the queue.

action_attempted: Cross-check reports against seeded claim lifecycle
expected: Claim KPIs such as total claims, resolved/open counts, value at risk, and date filters.
actual: Reports page shows audit/identity metrics only; it does not expose claim totals or resolved/open claim accuracy.
merchant_experience: Manager cannot use Reports to run an end-of-shift claim operations review.
fix_summary: Added a real Claims Operations report with date filters, claim status/outcome totals, value at risk, refunded amount, resolution rate, overdue count, and CSV export.
tests_run: npx jest tests/api/claimsRoutes.test.ts tests/api/auditTrailClaims.test.ts tests/lib/claimsSla.test.ts tests/lib/customerResponses.test.ts tests/lib/claimsReporting.test.ts tests/lib/claimsWorkflowClient.test.ts tests/lib/claimsStore.test.ts --runInBand
retest_result: Passed: /reports?range=30d showed non-zero claims operations metrics and an export link backed by current claim data.

action_attempted: Find customer-safe denial/approval response after outcome
expected: Copy decision, customer message, or separate customer-facing reason field.
actual: No customer communication workflow or customer-safe reason field is visible.
merchant_experience: Agents must hand-write sensitive responses from internal fraud notes, creating compliance and tone risk.
fix_summary: Added decision-based customer-safe response templates, copy-to-clipboard, internal-risk-term guardrails, and customer_response_copied event recording.
tests_run: npx jest tests/api/claimsRoutes.test.ts tests/api/auditTrailClaims.test.ts tests/lib/claimsSla.test.ts tests/lib/customerResponses.test.ts tests/lib/claimsReporting.test.ts tests/lib/claimsWorkflowClient.test.ts tests/lib/claimsStore.test.ts --runInBand
retest_result: Passed: denied customer response rendered safe language, copy worked, and no internal fraud/watchlist phrases appeared in the customer-facing text.

action_attempted: Set claim to Pending/Awaiting carrier info
actual: Claim status options are not exposed in the panel; only outcome Pending exists, which is not the same as claim status.
merchant_experience: Analysts cannot park a claim while waiting for carrier proof without leaving it as generic under review/open.
fix_summary: Added merchant-friendly Pending external evidence status with required note, queue/filter visibility, SLA visibility, and immutable status-change events.
tests_run: npx jest tests/api/claimsRoutes.test.ts tests/api/auditTrailClaims.test.ts tests/lib/claimsSla.test.ts tests/lib/customerResponses.test.ts tests/lib/claimsReporting.test.ts tests/lib/claimsWorkflowClient.test.ts tests/lib/claimsStore.test.ts --runInBand
retest_result: Passed: claim was set to Pending external evidence, visible in panel/history and supported by status filters.

action_attempted: Review audit trail attribution for claim actions
expected: Claim actions attributed by user/team with timestamps.
actual: Route lands on Data & privacy settings, not an audit trail of claim activity.
merchant_experience: Manager cannot prove who made claim decisions during the shift.
fix_summary: Added append-only claim_events with actor attribution, route/page audit-trail integration, merchant scoping, and claim action event display.
tests_run: npx jest tests/api/claimsRoutes.test.ts tests/api/auditTrailClaims.test.ts tests/lib/claimsSla.test.ts tests/lib/customerResponses.test.ts tests/lib/claimsReporting.test.ts tests/lib/claimsWorkflowClient.test.ts tests/lib/claimsStore.test.ts --runInBand
retest_result: Passed: /settings/audit-trail shows claim events such as reopened, reversed, copied response, status changed, and resolved with timestamps and claim resources.
